title: ILLUME/Modern New Condo/ Pool & Downtown Views/Gym
description:
POOL IS OPEN MARCH 1.  Located in the very-desirable Gulch-view area, our condo was finished in December 2019 and has city views. The building is ultra-modern, secure, has pool and fitness center, grilling area and free parking in code-accessed gated garage below. Building entry is code-accessed,also. Excellent alternative to pricy nearby hotels. Five-minute walk to the Gulch. Less than a mile  to Broadway. Uber rides downtown about $6-8.

The space
Large bedroom, bath and living area. Everything new as if 1/2020.  Pool, fitness center, outdoor grill and kitchen. Balcony seats four and has a view of the pool.  Illume is a luxury condo experience. The pool is open March 15. The short term rental permit number is:  T2019076678.

Guest access
Entire condo. Pool, fitness center, outdoor grill and kitchen.

Other things to note
Unforeseen circumstances happen so we strongly advise you to purchase trip insurance in case you have flight problems, sickness, or other circumstances!

CMA Fest is $375 per night with a 5 night minimum!
